title: Customer success
description: Every customer's ARR from its closed-won recurring deals, with its next renewal and its CSM, and net and gross revenue retention over any period: the customers paying when it starts, what they pay at its end, and what churned, contracted and expanded, by segment and by CSM. New customers count apart. Deals without a company, an ARR or a contract length are listed, never guessed silently. Product usage highlights churn risk and expansion with evidence, configurable thresholds and dismissals.
